subject.title: feat: add tools.fs.roots — per-agent filesystem roots with access modes

question: After the explicit-root widening bug is fixed, should OpenClaw accept `tools.fs.roots` as the core filesystem-root config and plugin-facing media access contract?
rationale: This PR creates new operator-facing config and SDK-visible security behavior; code review can identify the blocker, but maintainers must decide whether this is the supported long-term policy surface.

options.title: Accept after boundary repair
options.body: Fix the remaining localRoots widening bug, rebase, and then evaluate the API/security contract for merge.

options.title: Redesign before merge
options.body: Pause this PR and ask for a smaller design that separates host filesystem roots, media roots, and Plugin SDK exposure more explicitly.

options.title: Decline core surface
options.body: Close the PR if maintainers want this class of per-agent filesystem policy to stay outside OpenClaw core for now.

recommendation.title: Accept after boundary repair
recommendation.body: Fix the remaining localRoots widening bug, rebase, and then evaluate the API/security contract for merge.
